title: Task Status
description: A state transition update for a task command.

robot_id.description: Unique lowercase DNS label identifier for the robot.

id.description: Correlation id of the command, null for locally-issued tasks.

detail.description: Human-readable detail about the current state.

source.description: Origin of the command: fleet-issued or locally-issued on the robot.

stamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision for this status update.

terminal.description: True if this state is terminal (rejected, succeeded, or failed).
